steps.domain_action: crude feed stock is introduced to the reboiler heat source
thermal energy drives initial vapor ascent into the fractional column
vapor enters the first theoretical plate stage for composition evaluation
partial condensation separates the stream into vapor and liquid components
the vapor arm continues upward enriched with the desired light component
a secondary sub-fractional split occurs within the ascending vapor
azeotropic components are identified as inseparable at the current pressure
thermal equilibration reunites the azeotropic constituents into a single stable phase
heavy molecules are captured in the reflux and descend to the previous plate
downward reflux flow maintains the mass balance required for continuous operation
equilibration of the returning liquid and rising vapor restores the total molar mass
the purified vapor stream enters the final condenser stage
the molecule reaches self-identity at the terminal boiling point signature
the refractive index and purity of the fraction are permanently recorded
the final purified product is secured in the distillate receiver vessel
